details:
- rebuild with newer golang version 1.22.9-1.el9_2.tuxcare.els28 to fix
  the following Go standard-library CVE tracked for this package
  - CVE-2026-42504: fix mime quadratic complexity in DecodeHeader, which
    skipped only the leading "=?" of an undecodable encoded-word and so
    burned CPU on a header carrying many invalid ones
